title: [review] lora_ipv6_mesh-mkk4: SosResource discarded in bind_coap_udp, no app-layer control
description:
In python/src/lichen/coap/udp_server.py, the change creates SosResource() inline and passes it to build_site(), but the reference is never stored or returned. This means no application-layer code can:
1. Call sos.retrigger() to pulse the periodic beacon every 30s (required per SosResource docstring)
2. Call sos.activate() or sos.cancel() programmatically (e.g., from a hardware button)

CoAP clients can still PUT/DELETE/GET/Observe over the wire, but host-side programmatic control is impossible. The test file test_sos_resource.py correctly holds the reference, but bind_coap_udp does not.

Fix: either return the SosResource alongside the aiocoap.Context, accept it as an optional parameter, or provide a way for callers to access it.
